build_model: build a PyTorch model from config using resnet, mlpnet, cnn, mobilenet, efficientnet, or vgg with GPU support
build_model_stats_flops: build a model and compute its FLOPs count using the configured model type from pycls config
build_model_stats_params: build a model and compute its parameter count using the configured model type from pycls config
review_MODEL_TYPES: review the supported model types registry mapping resnet, mlpnet, cnn, mobilenet, efficientnet, and vgg to their classes
refactor_build_model_ddp: refactor the build_model function to support custom device placement or alternative distributed training strategies
